dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are the Institute's research projects going?

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: Some projects were restarted, some have been suspended, some of the researchers have returned to duty, some were furloughed...

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: It's just as Monsieur Choiseul said, everything is in order, and that is enough. I'd rather not have another "explosive surprise".

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: Order. That is what the highest priority is...
